name: stripo
description: Create and edit emails and templates with Stripo.

marketplace.name: stripo
marketplace.description: Stripo Agent Plugin: skills for creating and editing emails with any AI agent.

codexInterface.longDescription: Create emails from a brief, template, HTML or screenshot. Generate and edit images, update text, links and styles in existing emails and templates, and review desktop and mobile previews. The connect skill registers the Stripo MCP server with your organization's Client ID.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Stripo email from this description
Change the copy, links or images in an existing Stripo email

client_id.title: Stripo Client ID
client_id.description: Your organization's MCP Client ID from Stripo Workspace Settings → MCP integration (an Owner or Admin copies it). /stripo:connect registers the stripo-mcp server with it; leave it empty if stripo-mcp is already configured.

mcpDependency.description: Stripo MCP server for emails, templates, image generation/editing and business profiles. Register it with the plugin's connect skill and your organization's Client ID, then authorize it in your agent. See the plugin README.
